verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents a broad public HTTP API surface (event ingestion, dashboard REST API, cohort management, event/property CRUD, experiment/feature-flag APIs) plus a confirmed OpenAPI spec and llms.txt/docs.md endpoints for machine consumption, indicating a well-documented, programmatically drivable API. missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of API completeness/reliability and no evidence of official client libraries per language beyond SDK mentions.
